title: Find the Length of a Linked List Cycle
problemStatement: Given the head of a singly linked list, determine whether the list contains a cycle. If a cycle exists, return the number of nodes in the cycle. Otherwise, return 0.
input: A linked list. The testing system may internally create a cycle.
output: The length of the cycle, or 0 if no cycle exists.
constraints: Number of nodes is in the range [0, 10^5].
